title: Only 3% Of Eligible People Donate Blood
hook: Most eligible people can donate blood; only 3% actually do.
closing: Hospitals depend on a tiny donor pool that keeps shrinking.
question: Would you donate blood?

segments.say: Only 3 percent of eligible people donate blood. Hospitals depend on a tiny volunteer pool.
Blood donor volume fell to an index of 60. Fewer people are replacing regular donors.
